zh.title: CDB Aviation 向 Norwegian 交付首架 737-8　四架租賃案開始執行
zh.summary: 這是 CDB Aviation 首度向 Norwegian 出租飛機，四架 737-8 租約源自雙方 2024 年 12 月簽署的協議。
body: CDB Aviation 於 2026 年 9 月 29 日宣布，已向 Norwegian 交付四架 Boeing 737-8 租賃案中的首架飛機。這架飛機也是 CDB Aviation 首度出租給 Norwegian 的航機。
CDB Aviation 表示，四架飛機屬於雙方在 2024 年 12 月簽署的租賃協議。公告未提供其餘三架的個別交付日期，也未揭露本次租賃的財務條件。
Norwegian 執行長 Geir Karlsen 表示，接收首架由 CDB Aviation 提供的 737-8 是公司機隊更新的一部分。這次交付使原有租約開始落實，但不代表四架飛機已全數到位。

en.title: CDB Aviation delivers first of four 737-8s to Norwegian
en.summary: The delivery starts a four-aircraft lease agreed in December 2024 and marks CDB Aviation's first aircraft placed with Norwegian.
body: CDB Aviation announced on September 29, 2026 that it had delivered the first of four Boeing 737-8 aircraft to Norwegian. The aircraft is also the lessor's first jet placed on lease with the carrier.

CDB Aviation said the four aircraft are covered by lease agreements signed by the companies in December 2024. The announcement did not provide individual delivery dates for the other three jets or disclose the financial terms of the leases.

Norwegian chief executive Geir Karlsen described the first 737-8 delivery from CDB Aviation as part of the airline's continuing fleet renewal. The handover begins implementation of the existing agreement; it does not mean all four aircraft have been delivered.

facts.claim: CDB Aviation announced the delivery of the first of four Boeing 737-8 aircraft to Norwegian on 2026-09-29.
The delivery is CDB Aviation's first aircraft placed on lease with Norwegian.
The four aircraft are part of lease agreements signed in December 2024.
